requirements.problem_vi: Tài khoản bị khóa hoặc không đăng nhập được khi sử dụng ứng dụng.
requirements.title_vi: Sửa lỗi tài khoản không đăng nhập được
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to log into my account, so that I can use the app without issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has a valid account, when they attempt to log in, then they should be successfully logged into their account.
Given the user has an active account, when they try to access their account, then they should not receive an account locked message.
Given the user has recently created an account, when they attempt to log in, then they should be able to log in without being blocked.

requirements.problem_vi: Mở ứng dụng thường xuyên bị chuyển sang Shopee.
requirements.title_vi: Cải thiện trải nghiệm quảng cáo
requirements.user_story: As a shopper, I want to use the app without being redirected to Shopee, so that I can enjoy my shopping experience without interruptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is browsing the app, when they interact with any feature, then they should not be redirected to Shopee unexpectedly.
Given the user is playing a game within the app, when they receive an advertisement, then the advertisement should not cause the app to exit or redirect to Shopee.
Given the user is scrolling through content, when they click on a link, then they should remain in the app without being taken to Shopee.

requirements.problem_vi: Người dùng muốn có tùy chọn xem hàng trước khi thanh toán.
requirements.title_vi: Bổ sung tính năng xem hàng trước khi thanh toán
requirements.user_story: As a buyer, I want to see the product before payment, so that I can ensure its quality.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product in the cart, when I choose to view the product, then I can see the product details before making the payment.
Given a product listing, when I click on the 'view product' option, then I can see the actual product image and description.
Given a checkout page, when I select the option to view the product, then I am redirected to the product details page.
